scripts/source_documentation_audit.py

Python · Tier B

Check tiered documentation coverage using only local maintained source.

Usage

Run from any directory; --check exits nonzero for every outstanding defect, or for regressions and link/classification failures when --baseline is supplied.

Inputs

--root selects the repository; --prefix limits source review; --report-dir requests deterministic JSON and Markdown reports; --baseline selects reviewed debt.

Side effects

Optional report files are written only to the requested directory.

Cleanup

Analysis owns no services or temporary databases; process exit releases memory.

@see src/manual/documentation_audit.py

@see docs/engineering/source-documentation-standard.md

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
main 32 Print counts, optionally write reports, and enforce coverage only with --check. Report mode permits inspecting an incomplete migration without disguising its failed status; the emitted report always retains ok: false when gaps exist. An explicit baseline adds a separate regression verdict without changing that full-coverage result. Malformed or unreadable baselines fail closed.
